title: Speaking — Computer habits
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on computer habits.

questions: What places are within walking distance of your home?
When are the streets near your home most lively?
Which part of the area would you show to a visitor?
Which tasks do you prefer to do on a computer?
When do you choose a phone instead?

part2.topic: Describe a piece of software that helped you learn or organise something.
part2.closing: and explain what improvement you would make to it.

questions: How can software designers help people who have little technical experience?
When can the introduction of new software make an organisation less efficient?
How has everyday life connected with computer habits changed for people of different ages?
